treatment_method: Pretreat 1 wt% NaOH at 70 C for30 min; soak finish at70 C for1 h, squeeze and cure180 C for8 min; source says sequence repeated twice; water rinse then dry70 C for1 h
TG_locator: Thermogravimetric analysis section: exact prose accompanying Figure 5 and Table 3
LOI_locator: Flammability and washing durability section: initial FR-L/C LOI54%, distinguished from fifty-wash discussion
conditions_locator: Experimental: Characterization (TG and LOI), Materials and Preparation of flame retardant lyocell/cotton fabric
pairing_evidence: The full COP-containing FR-L/C label is used for the initial TG analysis and initial LOI54 result. The no-COP/no-phosphoric-acid vertical-flame controls and30/50 durability washes are separately described; none is substituted. Preparative tap-water rinsing removes unbound finish and is not a durability cycle.

limitations: Exact TG values come from original publisher prose, not a recovered Table3 cell or graph estimate. T5=71C is the author-reported5%-mass-loss temperature, not a relabeled decomposition onset. Source naming alternates creatinine/creatinol O-phosphate; retain COP without normalizing chemical identity. TG-IR nitrogen,15mg and30mL/min are a separate method and are not assigned to air TG. Introductory cotton LOI18 is not measured control LOI. Fifty-wash LOI reduction12.7% is not converted to an exact value and has no matched TG. No PDF pixel QA claimed.
